identitySignals: Agenda names 'Civic Design Studio' in Oakland, CA; the California Arts Council grantee page lists Civic Design Studio at 4124 MacArthur Blvd. Suite B, Oakland, CA 94619 with website civicdesignstudio.com
Its own website says it partners with 6 Oakland Unified high schools and is a close industry partner with OUSD, matching the agenda's workplace training partner / student internship MOU
Oaklandside reporting and OUSD materials link Civic Design Studio to the OUSD ECCCO summer internship program, matching the agenda title
research.notes: Legal name, legal structure, EIN and CA entity number were not found (not in ProPublica under this name; may operate under a fiscal sponsor or different legal name). Phone not found on site pages. Only email found is a grants gmail address, omitted.

profile.address: 4124 MacArthur Blvd. Suite B, Oakland, CA 94619
profile.summary: Civic Design Studio is an Oakland-based arts and design organization that works with local schools, artists and community partners. It runs paid creative internship and apprenticeship pathways for high school students and creates public art such as murals and planter installations in Oakland neighborhoods.

sources.title: Civic Design Studio - California Arts Council
Civic In Schools - Civic Design Studio

review.notes: Oakland address and website are confirmed on the California Arts Council page, and the studio's own site describes itself as an OUSD industry partner. Independent reporting (Oaklandside) ties it to the OUSD ECCCO summer internship program, matching the agenda MOU. The 'paid' and 'murals' wording in the summary is not in the cited pages but is supported by that independent reporting and the squad page (apprentices, muralists), so it is kept.
